fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.examples.dependentcounters

Class DependentCounterModelFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.AbstractAtomicModelFactory
      • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.examples.dependentcounters.DependentCounterModelFactory
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AtomicModelFactoryI, java.io.Serializable

    public class DependentCounterModelFactory
extends AbstractAtomicModelFactory
    The class DependentCounterModelFactory defines a factory to create DependentCounterModel instances.

    Description

    Very simple example to show the use of factories to create instances of atomic models. Usually, factories are used when the model class requires more constructor parameters to be created than the ones defined by the standard constructor of AtomicModel. In such a case, the model factory can store the complementary parameters through a "set" method and then use them in the method createAtomicModel.
